providerAccess.description: Send verification, reset, invitation, and instant-link emails through the site-owned email provider.
providerAccess.dataClassification: Email recipients, subjects, bodies, token values, and provider headers are sensitive or PII and must not appear in tags, logs, analytics, site-brain records, manifests, or bootstrap files.

runtimeCalls.purpose: Send account verification emails through the site-owned email provider.

context.description: Send a verification email through the site-owned provider.

optionalDeliveryContext.duplicateRisk: boolean; true when an earlier attempt may have reached a provider

runtimeCalls.idempotency: at-least-once; stable outbox key is mandatory correlation input for new hosts and suppresses duplicates only when the selected provider explicitly supports idempotency
runtimeCalls.fallback: fail closed with provider_unavailable or retryable_downstream_failed

runtimeCalls.purpose: Send password reset emails through the site-owned email provider.
runtimeCalls.idempotency: password reset token id or outbox event id
runtimeCalls.fallback: fail closed with reset email unavailable state

runtimeCalls.purpose: Send organization invite emails through the site-owned email provider.
runtimeCalls.idempotency: invite id or outbox event id
runtimeCalls.fallback: persist invite, mark email pending or failed

runtimeCalls.purpose: Send redacted security alert emails through the site-owned email provider.
runtimeCalls.idempotency: security event id or outbox event id

observability: retry and failure count by redacted cause

providerAccess.description: Store and read user profile images through the site-owned storage provider when image uploads are enabled.
providerAccess.dataClassification: Profile images can be personal data; object names, filenames, user identifiers, and storage URLs must be redacted from logs and tags unless the host marks them safe.

runtimeCalls.purpose: Store user profile images through the site-owned storage provider.

context.description: Write a profile image to the site-owned storage provider.

runtimeCalls.idempotency: upload request id and target object reference
runtimeCalls.fallback: fail closed with image upload disabled

runtimeCalls.purpose: Read profile image references through the site-owned storage provider.

observability: storage read and write count by feature

hostInternalOrHandoffOnly: OAuth and OIDC providers remain settings/secrets/route handoff until Cedros publishes a provider family.
Discord and Telegram notifications remain downstream service handoff unless Cedros publishes a notification provider.
Privacy sidecar, wallet, balance, compliance, and affiliates calls remain host service or official extension handoff items.
hostHandoff: Exact host email provider request/response schema, sender, reply-to, consent, template, timeout, and retry policy.
Email hosts must accept the additive contractVersion=1, idempotencyKey, attempt, and duplicateRisk fields on email.send while remaining compatible with requests that omit them.

Email hosts should return JSON with optional providerMessageRef. If they implement real idempotency, retries of one idempotencyKey must return the original acceptance without sending again; otherwise the key is correlation-only and duplicate delivery remains possible.
Exact host storage provider request/response schema, path prefix, media URL policy, timeout, retry, delete, and retention policy.
Provider usage/cost records filterable by extensionId, accessId, feature, and safe tags.
